prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet is live! Here is how to control, hide, or chat with them anytime.", "Desktop Controls Summary", "Got It, Launch Desktop Pet"]
1: ["Signing in automatically saves and restores your existing pets to this device.", "Safe Sync: Pet Data Protected"]
2: ["Create Your Custom Pet", "Upload a clear photo with strong lighting. If photo processing encounters issues, default templates are applied instantly.", "Upload Pet Photo", "Best results: Single animal, well-lit, clear background."]
3: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Choose how you want to bring your desktop to life with animated AI companions.", "Start Journey"]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Render", "We are placing your pet on your screen background now.", "Rendering pet sprites...", "Force Display Pet"]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name and sign their official adoption paper.", "Pet Name", "Personality: Playful & Curious"]
6: ["Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Pet", "Your current pet progress will be linked safely to your account. Returning users will seamlessly restore their saved pets.", "Sign In & Sync"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready!", "Follow this quick 3-step guide to interact with your pet anywhere on your desktop.", "Desktop Shortcuts", "Finish Onboarding"]
8: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select your favorite pet style to get started.", "Pet Categories"]
9: ["Select Your Setup Experience", "Pick Express for 1-click default pets (under 60s) or Custom for photo-based creation.", "Express Path: Ready in < 1 minute"]

verdicts.problem: Asks user to sign an adoption paper, soliciting personal information (signature/name).
